title: Murabahah Ibra' Settlement
description: Computes a deferred-price instalment schedule in integer minor units: per-period profit and principal split, outstanding cost and selling price, and deferred profit. It derives the rebate on early settlement, the variable-rate per-period rebate, and the non-delivery case that also rebates undisbursed principal. Outputs are arithmetic and rule checks against the cited regulator paragraphs, not a fatwa, Shariah certification, legal opinion or regulatory approval.

authority.description: Authority profile. Only the pinned regulator profile is supported; any other value, absent or null, is refused by name.

cost_of_purchase_minor.description: Acquisition cost in integer minor units, at least 1. A present null or float is refused.

cpr_bp.description: Contracted ceiling profit rate in whole basis points, 0 to 100000.

instalment_minor.description: Level monthly instalment in integer minor units, at least 1.

selling_price_minor.description: Contracted selling price used by the schedule, not below the acquisition cost.

selling_price_stated_minor.description: Optional stated price. When present it is emitted with the schedule price and the difference as a named residual.

epr_periods.description: Optional prevailing-rate periods of from_month, epr_bp and instalment_minor. The first period starts at month 1 and months strictly increase.

settlement_month.description: Optional month at which early settlement occurs.

instalment_due_minor.description: Optional unpaid instalment at settlement, in minor units.

early_settlement_charges.description: Optional recovery costs of cost_type and amount_minor. Permitted types: unrecovered_discount and unrecovered_initial_cost. Lost profit and marketing are refused.

late_payment_minor.description: Optional pass-through late-payment amount, shown separately from the rebate.

non_delivery.description: Optional non-delivery case: undisbursed_principal_minor and first_sign_month. Requires settlement_month.

conventional_loan.description: Optional conventional comparison: principal_minor, annual_rate_bp, tawidh_minor and gharamah_minor.

mcp_tool_definition.name: compute_murabahah_ibra_settle
mcp_tool_definition.description: Computes a deferred-price instalment schedule and the rebate on early settlement in integer minor units, including the variable-rate and non-delivery cases. Arithmetic only, not a ruling.

selling_price_minor.description: Contracted selling price in minor units.

input_schema_provenance: Top-level properties are exactly the policy_parameters members the kernel reads. Every refusal is a structured refusal payload, and x_null_distinct is declared on each property because the kernel refuses a present null with a different named code from an absent field.
author: PostOakLabs
